applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Sixth Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Commercial banks must note that sub-paragraph 21(i)(b) of the Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy Directions, 2025 has been deleted.

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025
